SecurityPolicy.metaDescription: Security, privacy and acceptable-use policy for the console.
SecurityPolicy.title: Secure Usage Policy
SecurityPolicy.intro: This policy explains how we keep your account safe, what we expect from you when using the console, what data we collect for security purposes, and how to report a security issue.
SecurityPolicy.section1Item1: This policy applies to every user with access to the console, including administrators, editors and viewers.
SecurityPolicy.section1Item2: By signing in you agree to follow the rules below. We may update this policy and will publish the new version on this page.
SecurityPolicy.section2Item1: Never share your password or session with anyone, including coworkers and IT staff. Each person must use their own account.
SecurityPolicy.section2Item2: Use a strong, unique password of at least 8 characters that combines uppercase, lowercase, numbers and a symbol.
SecurityPolicy.section2Item3: Enable multi-factor authentication (MFA) on your account whenever it is available, and protect the device that receives the codes.
SecurityPolicy.section2Item4: Sign out when you finish a session on a shared or public device, and notify us immediately if you suspect your account is compromised.
SecurityPolicy.section3Item1: Do not attempt to bypass authentication, rate limits, audit logs, or any other security control.
SecurityPolicy.section3Item2: Do not scrape, mass-export or automate requests against the console without prior written approval.
SecurityPolicy.section3Item3: Do not upload malware, run penetration tests, or probe the system for vulnerabilities without authorization.
SecurityPolicy.section3Item4: Do not use the console to harass, defame, or violate the rights of others, or for any unlawful purpose.
SecurityPolicy.section4Item1: Account data: your name, email address used to sign in, role, and account status.
SecurityPolicy.section4Item2: Authentication data: hashed password, multi-factor secrets, and recent login attempts (success/failure).
SecurityPolicy.section4Item3: Security telemetry: IP address, user agent, and timestamps for sign-in attempts, used to detect abuse and protect your account.
SecurityPolicy.section5Item1: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt before storage. We never see, log or transmit your plaintext password.
SecurityPolicy.section5Item2: Session cookies are signed and encrypted, marked HttpOnly and SameSite, and served over HTTPS in production (TLS).
SecurityPolicy.section5Item3: Multi-factor authentication and rate limiting on sensitive endpoints reduce the impact of credential theft.
SecurityPolicy.section5Item4: Access to production data is limited to authorized personnel and is reviewed regularly.
SecurityPolicy.section6Item1: If you discover a vulnerability, suspect a breach, or notice suspicious activity on your account, report it to us right away.
SecurityPolicy.section6Item2: Please include reproduction steps, timestamps, and screenshots when relevant. Do not publicly disclose the issue before we respond.
SecurityPolicy.contactBody: Send security reports and questions to
SecurityPolicy.footerNotice: This document is provided for transparency. It does not replace any contractual or legal obligations.
